Deferral of July 2020 POA means approx. £17.1k due in January 2021.
POA for July 2021 of £5,725.

Includes CGT of £1,961.20 due on sale of Lesson Road.

POA for July 2021 of £1,967

This is a highly tax-efficient way to extract value from the business while saving for retirement. With annual allowances of up to £60K (as of 2025/26) and the ability to carry forward unused reliefs from the past 3 years, it can be a useful tool for long-term planning.
